producer_report.summary: Config::validate now refuses any athena.toml whose [models] roles (reader, producer_default, producer_allowed, verifier, hard_producer_model) name no Opus, no Sonnet or no Haiku model. It returns the new ConfigError::ModelFamily(family). The match is a case-insensitive substring, so version bumps pass, and [models.names] is not read. Config unit tests drop each family and assert the exact error. A new integration test, model_roster.rs, parses the real athena.toml, checks that a haiku-less copy is refused, checks the OLY-B-SET-02 spec entry, and checks the Jev constants. OLY-B-SET-02 in docs/spec.toml now has a real mechanism, and its measure ends `status: not shown`. CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and xtask/shard-timings.txt has the new unit (5.00 s is an estimate). jev.rs, lib.rs, athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are unchanged, and there is no ROSTER. The full `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast` exited 0.

It returns a new ConfigError variant when [models] roles lack an Opus, a Sonnet or a Haiku model. No hard-coded ROSTER list is added, and jev.rs is unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: I added ConfigError::ModelFamily(&'static str) and the family loop in Config::validate; Config::parse calls validate. I added a MODEL_FAMILIES constant of three name fragments, which is not a model-id roster. `git status --short` lists only CHANGELOG.md, config.rs, docs/spec.toml and xtask/shard-timings.txt as modified, plus the new model_roster.rs. jev.rs and lib.rs are not listed. `cargo test -p athena-data` passed: 211 unit tests plus 3 in repo_config.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-data`: new unit tests build a Config with the Haiku, Sonnet or Opus model removed from the roles and assert Config::parse returns the new error for each. The same text with all three present parses. These tests fail if the validation is removed.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-data` passes. New tests in config.rs: roles_without_haiku_are_refused, roles_without_sonnet_are_refused, roles_without_opus_are_refused, roles_with_all_three_families_load_and_case_does_not_matter, and the_display_names_table_does_not_satisfy_the_family_check. The `edited` helper panics if a replacement pattern misses. Each refusal case asserts the exact ModelFamily(family) variant and that the message names the family and says "every athena.toml". Without the check in validate, those texts parse and the assertions fail. I did not run that deletion as a separate experiment.

open_issues: Past athena.toml files may lack a family name. CI's `athena check --history` job is the check that would show this, and it cannot be run here. If it fails on an old commit, report it; do not weaken the rule.

trailers_stopped (invariant.rs) and cutover_job_for (gh/records.rs) read the parent config with `.ok()`, so a refused config falls back silently. I left this as it is, because only configs that set [history] cutover_job matter and those carry all three families. The gate, core and cli tests built on the real athena.toml still pass.
The refusal applies to every athena.toml Athena loads, including a user repository's, by design. The error text, the doc comment and the CHANGELOG entry say so.
mistakes: My first draft of model_roster.rs imported ConfigError from the athena_data root, which does not compile. I fixed the import to athena_data::config::ConfigError.
learnings: athena_data re-exports only Config at the root; ConfigError is reached as athena_data::config::ConfigError.
The Bash hook allows one plain command at a time: no grep, tail or substitutions, and `cargo` takes a single build slot, so a long background run blocks other cargo commands.
Spec measure lines are single-line `measure = "...; status: ..."`, so a test that checks the ending must trim the closing quote.
desires: A way to read the output file of a background command. It sits outside the working directory, and I could only wait for the exit notification.
Access to the CI `athena check --history` job, to see past commits against the new rule.
